paragraphs.text: Olgard is a famed slayer and shieldbearer, traveling the land as a noble agent of the Skiltfolk of Nephalia on Innistrad . He is the father of the Gitrog monster cultist Mia .

Olgard left his daughter Mia in charge of their farm and went to serve with the Skiltfolk of Nephalia . While he was away, several villagers from his home fell to the Gitrog monster , and his daughter became one of its cultists.

Although humanity's great last stand during the Travails would be at the Battle of Thraben , Nephalia's coast was lined with smaller battlefields. Resistance came from all quarters: cathars, the skiltfolk mercenaries, merchants, elders - anyone who managed to resist Emrakul's corrupting influence and maddening presence for any time. The skiltfolk leader Olgard, who had spent months investigating the coastal cults, became a leader of this resistance, mustering his surviving companions to organize and train other defenders.
